newsitem.title: USA: Tyco closes purchase of AT&T submarine unit.
newsitem.headline: Tyco closes purchase of AT&T submarine unit.

text.p: Tyco International Ltd said Tuesday it had completed it purchase of telephone company AT&T Corp's submarine system business for about $850 million.
Tyco said it bought the system through its Submarine Systems Inc unit.
It said it will organize the unit within its Electrical and Electronic Components segment with its Simplex Technologies unit.
The group will make and install underwater fiberoptic telecommunications cable with estimated annual revenues totaling more than $1 billion, it added.
Tyco makes everything from security systems to electronic components to disposable medical products.
